title: gaph_v2 pipeline parameters
description: GAPH v2 end-to-end comparative variant evidence pipeline

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

help.description: Display general help, or detailed help for a named parameter, and exit.

helpFull.description: Display help for every pipeline parameter and exit.

ids_file.description: Path to the input file containing gene IDs

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved.

alignment_strategies.description: Comma-separated alignment strategies to run, or 'default' for the registry-defined default set.

clinvar_vcf.description: Path to ClinVar VCF file for annotation. Defaults to CLINVAR_VCF, then assets/reference/clinvar/clinvar.vcf.gz when present. ClinVar is required for annotation.

gnomad_cache_dir.description: Optional shared gnomAD regional cache directory. Defaults to GAPH_GNOMAD_CACHE_DIR, then $GAPH_ROOT/cache/gnomad when GAPH_ROOT is set.

chunk_size.description: Number of genes to process per chunk

target_annotation_gff3.description: Local NCBI RefSeq GFF3 for the target assembly. Defaults to GAPH_TARGET_ANNOTATION_GFF3, then assets/reference/ncbi/refseq/GCF_000001405.40_GRCh38.p14/genomic.gff.gz.

alignment_max_forks.description: Maximum concurrent tasks in each aligner process. The two minimap2 presets share one process and one limit; nucmer and BWA each have their own process. Total alignment concurrency is also bounded by executor CPU/queue limits.

alignment_partition_size.description: Maximum target genes per bounded alignment and annotation output partition.

annotation_max_forks.description: Maximum concurrent tasks for each annotation process, including bounded ClinVar/gnomAD partitions and VEP shards. Base partition tasks receive size-aware memory from event counts.

vep_backend.description: Ensembl VEP backend. Production cluster runs use the configured local release/cache; REST is available for small local runs.

vep_release.description: Declared Ensembl VEP release. Required for the local backend; REST resolves it when omitted and verifies it against the server when provided.

vep_executable.description: Local VEP executable or wrapper path. Used only by the local backend.

vep_cache_dir.description: Local indexed VEP cache directory. Required by the local backend.

vep_result_cache_dir.description: Optional shared immutable cache for completed VEP variant/gene results.

vep_result_cache_tile_size_bp.description: Genomic tile size for the shared VEP result cache.

vep_forks.description: CPUs and local VEP forks reserved for each bounded VEP annotation task.
